text.text_excerpt: China Kitchen is bomb! Seriously, I've done take out 3 times within 9 days. They make the best General Tso's Chicken (w broccoli). There doesn't seem to be a big difference between lunch & combination plates. & special plates comes w house special fried rice an an egg roll. The fried rice is on point too! The house special fried rice has chicken (?), pork, & shrimp in it. I also tried the Phoenix & Dragon (12$) which is 1/2 General Tso's Chicken & 1/2 Shrimp tossed in some orange sauce w peas & carrots. It came with white rice & was okay. The Shrimp w Garlic sauce (8$) and Beef & Scallops (11.50$) are tossed with baby corn, onions, green bell peppers, mushrooms, & carrots. Both are good. ...

First time trying. The place is very clean. And uncluttered. Looking for consistently good Chinese take out. I might have found it. Ordered wonton soup, house special lo mein and shrimp with lobster sauce and boneless mandarin chicken. Food was good. The lo mein was very good and well flavored. Only wish they would have used a smaller noodle. The boneless chicken was nice and brown and consisted of mostly white meat. The shrimp and lobster sauce and wonton soup were on par with other good Chinese restaurants My order was taken quickly and the guy behind the counter on New Year's Eve was very friendly. Don't envy him working this night. Overall very good. Will try again. Happy New Year.

Y'all already know what it is! Almost everyone has those nights where they wanna just get some Chinese takeout. You wanna sit back & relax, pop up the Netflix, and open up that traditional Chinese takeout box and eat some fried rice, lo mein, stirfry, or whatever it is that you are craving! I had recently gave a review to another Chinese restaurant that received 5 stars! Unfortunately, that place is ALL the way in Kenner and I can't be driving all the way over there for some Chinese takeout unless I happen to be out and about. Around my area, I seem to occasionally look for that Chinese restaurant that I can go to nearby and get some, and I think I may have found the place! CHINA KITCHEN!...
